story.text: The King and Queen of Hearts sit on their {THRONE}, and in the middle of the court is a dish of {TARTS}. The Knave stands before them in {CHAINS}. Twelve creatures sit in the {JURY}-box, writing very busily on {SLATES}. The first {WITNESS} is the Hatter, with a {TEACUP} in one hand and bread-and-butter in the other.
story.caption: Who stole the tarts?
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
